svg.title: Rectangular barrier: continuous top and interference resonances
svg.desc: Transmission at width parameter g=4 approaches 0.2 continuously at E/V0=1. Above the barrier, two resonances at 1.61685 and 3.46740 reach probability one. Equal masses and external potentials, stationary single-particle model.

g.text: Rectangular barrier: the top is continuous
g = 4 | equal masses and outer potentials | formula-derived, no measured data
Below top: evanescent region. Above top: oscillating internal wave and boundary interference.
